#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>

using namespace std;

bool DEBUG = true;
string name = "I";

class FastScanner {
public:
    istream* dis;
    static const int BUFFER_SIZE = 1 << 17;
    char buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
    int pointer;

    FastScanner(istream* input_stream) {
        dis = input_stream;
        pointer = 0;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int ret = 0;
        char b;
        do {
            b = nextByte();
        } while (b <= ' ');
        bool negative = false;
        if (b == '-') {
            negative = true;
            b = nextByte();
        }
        while (b >= '0' && b <= '9') {
            ret = 10 * ret + (b - '0');
            b = nextByte();
        }
        return negative ? -ret : ret;
    }

    long long nextLong() {
        long long ret = 0;
        char b;
        do {
            b = nextByte();
        } while (b <= ' ');
        bool negative = false;
        if (b == '-') {
            negative = true;
            b = nextByte();
        }
        while (b >= '0' && b <= '9') {
            ret = 10 * ret + (b - '0');
            b = nextByte();
        }
        return negative ? -ret : ret;
    }

    char nextByte() {
        if (pointer == BUFFER_SIZE) {
            dis->read(buffer, 0, BUFFER_SIZE);
            pointer = 0;
        }
        return buffer[pointer++];
    }

    string nextString() {
        string ret;
        char b;
        do {
            b = nextByte();
        } while (b <= ' ');
        while (b > ' ') {
            ret += b;
            b = nextByte();
        }
        return ret;
    }
};

int log2_int(int n) {
    return (int)ceil(log2(n));
}

int main() {
    FastScanner* scan;
    ostream* out;

    if (DEBUG) {
        scan = new FastScanner(&cin);
        out = &cout;
    } else {
        ifstream fin(name + ".in");
        ofstream fout(name + ".out");
        scan = new FastScanner(&fin);
        out = &fout;
    }

    float N = stof(scan->nextString());
    float P = stof(scan->nextString());

    for (int i = 0; i <= (int)N; i++) {
        double numerator = i * (i - 1) * (i - 2) / 6.0
                         + i * (i - 1) * (N - i) / 2.0
                         + i * (N - i) * (N - i - 1) / 4.0;
        double denominator = N * (N - 1) * (N - 2) / 6.0;
        double val = numerator / denominator;

        if (val >= P) {
            (*out) << i << "\n";
            break;
        }
    }

    if (!DEBUG) {
        delete scan;
    }

    return 0;
}
